project.description: Build and tag the PIC-SURE Gateway container image (the stack ingress behind httpd) from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace. This job does not compile and does not deploy -- deploy is exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/gateway" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
# Guard: this job does not compile; it needs the reactor's artifacts. if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS"/services/pic-sure-gateway/target/pic-sure-gateway-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
# env-file cascade (uploaded param > existing config > generated default) if [ -f gateway.env ]; then echo "A new gateway.env was loaded." cp gateway.env "$CONFIG_DIR/gateway.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/gateway.env" ]; then echo "Using existing gateway.env" else echo "Creating new gateway.env file." { echo "SPRING_PROFILE=aio" } > "$CONFIG_DIR/gateway.env" fi
# Build/tag only. Deploy happens exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. docker build -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-gateway:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-gateway/" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-gateway:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-gateway:LATEST
